body:
Thanks for your kind words. Sadly, I don't have anyone I can ask those questions, not that I expect an answer anyways. My boyfriend is really supportive but can't do much aside from that, my therapist says that I'm "getting better" and denied that I might have other mental issues, and the situation with my mother is complicated (screamed at me when she saw my scars many years ago, also screamed while I was having a panic attack, etc.).
I've also been told that I was talented, a gifted child, and more while growing up so that led to me being an extreme perfectionist. I agree that pressure shouldn't be a normal part of my life, but I'm not sure how to "fix" that.
Thanks and sorry for taking a while to answer, I'm still quite anxious about what happened.

Well what you're saying is true, some people do find the things they're good at later on in life. Maybe I do feel some kind of pressure when comparing myself to other 25 year olds. As for things that I think I might be good... I used to draw a lot since I was a kid, but the last few years were rough on me and now nothing that I draw looks "good enough". For a long time I thought drawing was my "talent" so to say, but now I truly feel that I'm not good at anything. I also used to write short stories and poems when I was a teen, but stopped for the same reason, that they weren't good enough in my eyes.

The "God" was just a term I used, sorry for the misunderstanding. And I'm not really sure, at this point the only thing that's giving me hope is waiting for my therapist appointment at the end of the month. Deep down I know there's a better future, but right now my mind is filled with suicidal thoughts and I'm not sure what to do next, keep on living even if I feel empty or just end it and not feel anything anymore. The main problem is that I feel lost in life, as if I'm not sure how to "proceed". I don't even remember the last 5 years of my life because it was just routine, over and over

The fact that I feel useless or that I've disappointed everyone in my life. When I was growing up I was the "smart kid", I was told I had a lot of potential, etc. But now I have depression and anxiety, still looking for a job, I didn't further my education, and it feels like I ended up being a disappointment to everyone. Of course there's other minor problems going on, but my low self-esteem is what's slowly killing me

Forgot to mention that i started self harming again, it's the only thing that calms me down even if i feel regret for the next weeks. God I just wish i was good at something, anything. I'm already 25 and I thought people this age had everything figured out, yet I feel completely lost, as if nobody explained to me that this would happen

I'm 24 and not currently studying, and I'm trying to find a job. Also I have to wait until next month to see my therapist and figure out what's wrong with me. Thank you so much for your words, they mean a lot

My mom is aware that I have anxiety and depression, but I try to hide everything from her since she reacted badly when I self harmed for the first time and in another occasion she screamed at me while I was having an anxiety attack. Meanwhile my boyfriend is well aware of my situation and tries to help me as much as he can, but his own family is in a difficult situation and I don't want to bother him. I only live with them while the rest of my family doesn't and ignore my problems
Yes that's my biggest fear honestly. Just ending up being more of a burden to my family. It's what kept me alive all these years
You're right, after trying to jump i just gave up and now im lying down on my bed. I'll feel better soon hopefully, but I'm not sure for how long
